name: A Shrine to Celeste
description: Every surface honours a woman named Celeste — her portrait above the piano, kept free of dust. Old Neil never stopped mourning her.

name: Vials of His Own Blood
description: Racks of small, carefully dated vials of dark red. Old Neil bled himself in measured amounts over years — unwilling to spill anyone else's.

name: The Alchemical Life Diagram
description: A forbidden 'Alchemical Life' diagram, copied from something that names itself the Hidden Sage — a method to make the dead live again, paid for in blood.

name: Twenty Years of Letters
description: Two decades of letters to Celeste, each recording another failed attempt to bring her back. The hope in them has curdled into something past reason.

name: Antigonus' Notebook
description: A leather notebook whose symbols seem to crawl when unobserved. Plainly a corrupting Beyonder artifact.

name: Spent Revolver
description: A service revolver, one chamber fired, the barrel still faintly warm.

name: The Wrong Reflection
description: The face in the mirror is not the one you remember wearing. You woke in a stranger's life.

name: Nighthawk's Warning
description: A Nighthawk admits the Church is already hunting the notebook — and you with it.

name: The Captain's Charge
description: The Nighthawk captain set you on the trail: Antigonus' notebook is a key the Church will kill for, and the University archives hold his name.

name: Antigonus in the Catalogue
description: The card catalogue confirms Antigonus was real — a long-dead devotee whose key volume has a call number but no book on the shelf.

name: The Missing Volume
description: The restricted shelf has one empty slot, its dust-shadow still fresh. Someone removed Antigonus' volume only recently.

name: The Chain of Owners
description: Abandoned marginalia traces the notebook through Welch and his circle — each reader driven mad, then dead. The list ends at Welch's lodging.

name: The Clerk's Excuse
description: The records clerk insists the restricted volume is 'out for rebinding' — a shade too quickly. He is covering for its disappearance.

name: The Butcher's Night Errand
description: Deep in the night, far from his shop, Bram Kell drags something heavy toward the canal. No honest delivery goes out at that hour.

name: The Thing Beneath the Butcher
description: Bram Kell's flesh split open and something else stood up inside his skin. The cheerful butcher of Iron Cross Street is a monster wearing a man.

name: The Thief-Taker's Night Stalk
description: Long after the corner has emptied, Sable Wren is still on it — motionless in a doorway, then following a frightened stranger with the patience of something that does not mean to lose them. No warrant moves like that.

name: The Hunt Wearing Sable Wren
description: Sable Wren's skin came apart and the thing the bad potion made of her stood up on the corner — the same blood as the butcher, a Hunter that lost the leash and hunts people now.

name: The Line-Handler's Night Haul
description: Well past midnight at the harbor breakwater, Leland Mack tips something heavy off the sea-wall — not cargo, not a crate. The splash is wrong. No honest dockhand hauls like that.

name: The Beast That Was Mack
description: Leland Mack's flesh came apart at the breakwater and something built for the hunt stood up in his place — a harbour beast shaped by a bad dose and years of poaching, and it hunts people now.

name: The Alchemist's Blood-Star
description: Past midnight, behind Old Neil's shuttered window, a chalk star drinks his own blood and he speaks a dead woman's name to the dark. No grief prays like that.

name: The Sage Wearing Old Neil
description: Old Neil's grief came apart and the Hidden Sage's pollution stood up in his skin — a Hermit that lost the leash, starlight and rot where the alchemist used to be.

name: The Clerk's After-Hours Reading
description: Long after the archive has locked, Ledger Finch is still deep in the restricted stacks, reading aloud from a volume with no catalogue number while the ink runs off the page toward her hands. No audit is done like that.

name: The Volume Wearing Ledger Finch
description: Ledger Finch's skin came apart in the stacks and the thing the forbidden volume made of her stood up — a Hermit that read too deep and lost the leash, ink and starlight where the clerk used to be.
